scope: Targeted primary-source novelty review; not an exhaustive systematic review or a reproduction of the cited experiments.

papers.title: Practice Makes Perfect: Planning to Learn Skill Parameter Policies
papers.domain: Robot skill parameter policies with a planner
papers.budget_role: Repeated one-practice-step selection during free time; not the complete remaining-budget optimization used by DP
papers.interaction_model: Composes skill competences through task plans; the selection counterfactual changes one skill competence
papers.diagnostic_cost: Estimates from collected transitions; planning to reach practice states is part of embodied interaction
papers.verified_overlap: Predicts competence gain and its effect on the overall task distribution; explicitly critiques Fail Focus.
papers.boundary: III-C shares weights between object instances of a parent skill. It is inaccurate to call the whole implementation independent skill models; the extrapolation and counterfactual are the relevant restriction.

papers.title: Deliberate Practice: Learning Robot Skills under a Budget
papers.domain: Structured robot skills, TAMP, CMA-ES interaction policies
papers.budget_role: Explicit whole practice-budget allocation to maximize expected downstream planning value
papers.interaction_model: Task-plan dependencies are modeled; competence prediction is parameterized by each skill's own allocation
papers.diagnostic_cost: Domain-specific improvement prior plus online estimates; no adaptive paid diagnostic selection in the reviewed allocation formulation
papers.verified_overlap: Direct competitor for budget-aware practice allocation and delayed benefits across multiple practice rounds.
papers.boundary: Optimization guarantees are conditional on the specified competence and abstract transition model. Uncertain priors are an explicit limitation; do not describe it as universally optimal learning.

papers.title: Model-Based Meta Automatic Curriculum Learning
papers.status: CoLLAs 2023, PMLR 232:846-860; supersedes the narrower 2022 workshop version for this comparison
papers.domain: RL meta-curriculum; MiniGrid and Habitat navigation
papers.budget_role: Lifetime terminal objective is explicit; algorithm approximates it using local k-iteration target improvement
papers.diagnostic_cost: Meta-training uses before/after validation over many lifetimes; online validation steps are omitted at deployment
papers.verified_overlap: Predicts which training task improves another target given learner history, then transfers the teacher to unseen related tasks.
papers.boundary: Final paper actually uses task-return histories as context; broader 2022 abstract suggestions about trajectories should not be reported as its implementation. Offline teacher cost is explicitly not the main optimization priority.

papers.title: Skill-it! A Data-Driven Skills Framework for Understanding and Training Language Models
papers.domain: LM continual pretraining, fine-tuning, out-of-domain data selection
papers.budget_role: Fixed sample and round budget, final average evaluation-skill loss objective
papers.interaction_model: Directed skill graph with a multiplicative loss-dynamics approximation; graph fixed while sampling adapts
papers.diagnostic_cost: Pairwise graph learning or cheaper short single-skill runs; smaller proxy models can supply the graph
papers.verified_overlap: Uses dependencies across skills and current evaluation losses to choose mixtures under a fixed training budget.
papers.boundary: Short probe runs and pretrained starting points already occur here; neither alone is a novel distinction.
papers.date_basis: first arXiv submission; proceedings text reviewed

papers.title: Data Mixing Laws: Optimizing Data Mixtures by Predicting Language Modeling Performance
papers.budget_role: Predicts mixture outcomes at target model size and training steps using nested scaling laws
papers.interaction_model: Per-domain loss depends on all mixture components; includes a continual-pretraining retention application
papers.diagnostic_cost: Fits laws using multiple smaller/shorter training runs; does not remove the cost of obtaining these runs
papers.verified_overlap: Predicts unseen mixture performance and a mixture threshold preserving original-domain performance.
papers.boundary: Do not assert that all prior mixture laws ignore forgetting or finite training duration.

papers.title: Aioli: A Unified Optimization Framework for Language Model Data Mixing
papers.budget_role: Final total loss objective; greedy round-level allocation derived from mixing dynamics
papers.interaction_model: Time-varying matrix estimates all group-loss responses to a mixture
papers.diagnostic_cost: Uses fraction delta of each training round for interleaved diagnostic learning; evaluations add inference overhead
papers.verified_overlap: Directly estimates cross-group responses during the current run and trains with the selected mixture for the rest of the round.
papers.boundary: Zero extra training runs does not mean free validation. The paper explicitly acknowledges evaluation cost. Merely adding short diagnostic training to allocation is insufficient novelty.

papers.title: Transferability for General Reasoning: An Automated Curriculum for Multi-Domain RLVR
papers.domain: Shared LLM policy, multi-domain GRPO/RLVR post-training
papers.budget_role: Online bandit feedback; no explicit remaining-horizon terminal success predictor in the reviewed algorithm
papers.interaction_model: Projected-gradient directional alignment plus local learnability
papers.diagnostic_cost: Reuses training gradients without extra probe rollouts; authors report less than 1% wall-clock overhead in their setup
papers.verified_overlap: Cheap transfer-aware multi-task RL allocation is already directly proposed.
papers.boundary: Its overhead claim belongs to its GRPO implementation, not SAC. A SAC analogue is an adaptation, not a reproduction of the published algorithm.

papers.title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
papers.status: arXiv preprint v1; very recent at the review cutoff
papers.domain: Robot harness, code/skill hypotheses and memory around frozen foundation policies
papers.budget_role: Physical-episode budget and explicit experiment cost in selection
papers.interaction_model: Code-skill joint effects and hypothesis support, not a shared SAC learning-response model
papers.diagnostic_cost: Expected hypothesis-entropy reduction divided by time/steps/GPU/reset cost
papers.verified_overlap: Robot experiment selection with diagnostic value per unit cost has explicit prior art.
papers.boundary: Information gain is not identical to expected final practice-allocation gain; this is a difference in acquisition target, not a claim that decision-theoretic VOI is new.

papers.title: Task Scheduling & Forgetting in Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning
papers.domain: PPO and MiniGrid; task scheduling and forgetting
papers.budget_role: Compares curricula and learning/retention trajectories, not a budget-end value predictor
papers.interaction_model: Empirically identifies asymmetric transfer and retention between related tasks
papers.diagnostic_cost: Experimental characterization; no claimed cheap predictive allocation system
papers.verified_overlap: Performance-only and repetition-only schedules fail to capture asymmetric task relationships.
papers.boundary: Finding one related-task transfer pair in MetaWorld would reproduce a known type of phenomenon, not establish a general selection rule.

papers.title: Meta-Learning from Learning Curves for Budget-Limited Algorithm Selection
papers.authors: Manh Hung Nguyen, Lisheng Sun-Hosoya, Isabelle Guyon
papers.domain: Budget-limited algorithm selection from partial learning curves
papers.budget_role: Training and evaluation share a limited resource budget; anytime area-under-curve objective
papers.interaction_model: Underlying candidate curves are precomputed/revealed, not modified by training a different candidate
papers.diagnostic_cost: Acquiring more curve information consumes budget; meta-data cost is separate
papers.verified_overlap: Meta-learning how much to inspect, train, pause or resume under a limited budget is established.
papers.boundary: Its anytime objective differs from our proposed terminal macro success. Shared-policy counterfactual paths cannot generally be reconstructed by concatenating its independent curves.

papers.title: DOGE: Domain Reweighting with Generalization Estimation
papers.authors: Simin Fan, Matteo Pagliardini, Martin Jaggi
papers.status: ICML 2024; method cross-checked in arXiv v2
papers.domain: LM domain sampling learned with a proxy model
papers.budget_role: Greedy one-step approximation to target-domain generalization
papers.interaction_model: Gradient alignment with aggregate target gradients
papers.diagnostic_cost: One proxy training stage plus gradient estimates; learned average weights transfer to a base model
papers.verified_overlap: Allocates more weight to sources contributing to aggregate target learning, not simply difficult domains.
papers.boundary: Proxy training and a one-step gradient surrogate differ from finite-horizon online robot success prediction.
papers.date_basis: reviewed arXiv method version; publication metadata checked separately

papers.title: Efficiently Identifying Task Groupings for Multi-Task Learning
papers.budget_role: Inference parameter/latency constraints; not remaining practice budget
papers.interaction_model: Measures one task update's effect on other task losses in a shared representation
papers.diagnostic_cost: Task affinity collected in one training run
papers.verified_overlap: Cheap directed task-affinity estimation and counterfactual gradient lookahead predate this project.
papers.boundary: Chooses task groupings/networks; using its affinity for practice allocation changes the decision problem.
papers.date_basis: first arXiv submission; current PDF method reviewed

papers.title: Teacher-Student Curriculum Learning
papers.status: 2017 preprint; this review uses the original publication/abstract rather than assigning a later journal date
papers.interaction_model: Progress and worsening performance motivate scheduling
papers.verified_overlap: Learning progress and revisiting deteriorating tasks are established curriculum signals.
papers.boundary: Not used to make detailed claims about implementation cost or finite-horizon optimality.

papers.title: Learning to Multi-Task by Active Sampling
papers.budget_role: Task selection by adaptive, bandit and actor-critic meta-learners
papers.verified_overlap: Adaptive sampling of tasks, including hard-task emphasis and a learned selector, is established.
papers.boundary: No detailed cost or horizon claims are made from the abstract.

papers.title: Freeze-Thaw Bayesian Optimization
papers.authors: Kevin Swersky, Jasper Snoek, Ryan Prescott Adams
papers.domain: Hyperparameter optimization with partial learning curves
papers.budget_role: Pause/resume/start candidate training using partially observed curves
papers.verified_overlap: Using cheap partial trajectories and information gain for deciding what to train next is longstanding.
papers.boundary: Adjacent conceptual prior; not treated as a direct robot-task scheduler.

papers.title: In-Context Freeze-Thaw Bayesian Optimization for Hyperparameter Optimization
papers.budget_role: Incremental resource allocation across training configurations
papers.interaction_model: Bayesian learning-curve extrapolation with a pretrained surrogate
papers.diagnostic_cost: Single-forward-pass prediction reduces online surrogate fitting overhead
papers.verified_overlap: Cheap online prediction through a pretrained learning-curve model is already studied.
papers.boundary: Cheap predictor inference is distinct from cheap collection of decision-relevant evidence.

papers.title: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
papers.budget_role: Does not allocate collection budget in the abstracted formulation
papers.verified_overlap: Gradient conflict and interference are established concepts.
papers.boundary: Optimizer intervention, not a like-for-like sampling baseline under the frozen SAC protocol.

papers.title: Automated Curriculum Learning for Neural Networks
papers.budget_role: Bandit task selection using progress signals
papers.interaction_model: Not used here to assess detailed cross-task dynamics
papers.verified_overlap: Automating allocation according to learning progress is established.
papers.boundary: Background only; the main novelty comparison rests on closer full-method papers.
